github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/cmd/fa.summary: Scriptable stand-in binary for an interactive coding harness, driven over a PTY by the chat package's integration tests (not a product binary).

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/cmd/ha.summary: HTTP + SSE daemon exposing pkg/chat so non-Go clients can drive multi-turn harness conversations across a process boundary (localhost, no auth in v1).
Thin CLI front-end for pkg/wrapper.Run that supervises an external agent harness under a pseudoterminal and forwards the user's terminal to it.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/docs/g.summary: Static site generator for the harness-wrapper docs: renders canonical markdown with chroma highlighting, theme-aware inlined SVG diagrams, and a shared layout.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/cmd/ch.summary: CLI that compares versions.json upstream-version pins against the npm registry's latest published version for each harness (run via make check-versions).

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/intern.summary: Clean-room Go re-implementation of the meta-harness environment-layer core: Provisioner (where) x Containment (what) meeting at the Workspace exec/file-transfer contract.

Acquirer.description: Optional, structurally-probed acquire hook of a Containment: acquires containment resources and returns a layer closed over them, cleaning up its own half-created resources on failure.

AliasMapper.description: Optional, structurally-probed host-URL rewrite of a ContainmentLayer, folded over the inner's for a two-hop alias.

Containment.description: Decides WHAT the agent may touch by contributing a ContainmentLayer of primitives that the core Compose combinator decorates a Workspace with.

ContainmentLayer.description: The set of primitives (exec wrap, path map, cross upload/download, teardown) a Containment contributes to the Compose combinator.

CredentialInjector.description: Applies secrets to a workspace, declares required capabilities and redactions, and cleans them up idempotently on destroy.

Provisioner.description: Decides WHERE the machine comes from: host-side preflight plus Create returning a Workspace for a WorkspaceSpec.

Redactor.description: Sink for secret strings to scrub from logs; the core registers every injector's redactions here before any Apply.

Workspace.description: An exec + file-transfer transport onto a machine: Exec, Upload/Download, path conventions, host-alias rewrite, and retention-honoring Destroy.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/intern.summary: The Daytona provisioner: clean-room Go driver for elastically provisioned remote sandboxes, depending only on injectable SDK interfaces so it is unit-testable without the real SDK.

DaytonaSandbox.description: The subset of the real @daytonaio/sdk Sandbox surface this driver depends on: execute command, upload/download file, labels, id, and delete.

DaytonaSdkClient.description: The subset of the real @daytonaio/sdk Daytona client surface this driver depends on: Create a sandbox and List sandboxes matching a query.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/intern.summary: The OpenShell containment driver: a clean-room Go wrapper of the openshell CLI transport over env.Containment, with policy generation, host-alias rewrite, and deterministic sandbox naming.
Scriptable fake interactive harness (script format + fluent Builder) that cmd/fakeharness compiles and chat.Open spawns over a real PTY to exercise timing-sensitive completion logic.
CLI that replays recorded PTY byte streams through each registered vt100 emulator candidate and reports fidelity, stability, and throughput against ground-truth text.
CLI that runs an interactive harness under wrapper supervision (interactive or scripted) while capturing the raw PTY byte stream into a corpus scenario directory.
CLI that generates a synthetic bake-off corpus exercising common TUI byte-stream primitives (SGR, cursor moves, alt-screen, box drawing) to validate bench plumbing.
Thin adapter interface around candidate vt100 emulator libraries so the bake-off harness can compare them on equal footing (feed bytes, read a text snapshot).

Emulator.description: Minimal bake-off surface over a vt100 emulator: Write raw PTY bytes, Snapshot the visible screen text, and report cursor position, size, and name.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/intern.summary: Comparison utilities for the screen-emulator bake-off: normalize, strip ANSI, exact match, and Levenshtein/normalized edit distance against ground-truth text.
Loads recorded bake-off scenarios from disk (bytes.raw + meta.json, optional expected.txt/transcript.jsonl) via Discover, Load, and WriteMeta.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/ch.summary: Go-level chat-conversation API over harness-wrapper: a Conversation owns one PTY-supervised harness process and exposes control acquisition, send, and turn-state events.

Store.description: Persists chat-level session metadata and turn records (not transcript bodies); create/get/update sessions and append/update/list turns, safe for concurrent use.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/ch.summary: In-memory chat.Store implementation shipped with v1: holds sessions and turns in process memory, lost on restart; suitable for tests and single-process gateways.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/di.summary: Read-only single source of truth for harness CLI availability and version on PATH for every harness in versions.json, with an in-memory detection cache.

Probe.description: Parses a harness binary's version from its --version (or equivalent) output; cheap, one subprocess call, treating parse failures as errors.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/en.summary: Host-side structured-turn client: RunStructuredTurn drives one turn over a B1 Workspace (upload prompt, exec guest structured-run, parse last JSON line, optional transcript download).

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/ha.summary: Per-harness orchestration + capability layer above pkg/wrapper: resolves a Profile to a run-specific ResolvedProfile and dispatches on confirmed resume/transcript capabilities.

HookProvider.description: Capability for hook-driven transcript acquisition: describes which native events to install and parses fired-hook stdin payloads into canonical events.

Profile.description: Per-harness entry point that self-registers in init(): names the harness and Resolve()s runtime capability detection into a ResolvedProfile.

Resumer.description: Produces the resume-specific CLI argument prefix (e.g. --resume <id>) for a given session id; returns nil for an empty id.

SessionIDExtractor.description: Recovers the harness-assigned session UUID from a single line of the harness's headless stream output; stateless and idempotent per line.

StaticHookProfile.description: Optional Profile interface exposing the harness's static HookProvider so a fired-hook subprocess can obtain the payload parser without running Resolve.

StreamParser.description: Parses a single line of the harness's headless stream output into zero or more canonical events; stateless, idempotent, and tolerant of non-event lines.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/ha.summary: Blank-import aggregator that registers every built-in harness profile so harness.For(name) resolves them; import for side effects.
harness.Profile for the Claude Code CLI: session-id extraction, --resume prefix, settings.json hook installation, hook-payload parsing, and live stream-json parsing.
harness.Profile for the OpenAI Codex CLI: resume-only, since Codex's stream/hook/export contracts are under-documented and deliberately not implemented on a guess.
harness.Profile for the Gemini CLI: resume-by-id plus shell hooks in a Claude-shaped settings.json; hooks-only, with no stream parser until the schema is confirmed.
harness.Profile for the OpenCode CLI: resume + session-id only; no shell hooks (in-process plugins) and stream/export deferred until validatable.
harness.Profile for the pi coding agent: session-id, resume (--session), and a live --mode json stream parser validated against pi 0.76.0; no hooks (no shell-hook contract).

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/sc.summary: Concurrent-safe wrapper around a vt10x vt100 emulator: feed raw PTY bytes via Write, read coherent Snapshots, and Subscribe to coalesced change notifications.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/tr.summary: Read-only view of harness-owned conversation logs: a leaf package defining the canonical Event/Turn model and the Reader interface per-harness parsers implement.

Reader.description: Reads a harness's persisted transcript for one session (by harness session UUID + working dir) into the canonical Event stream; safe for concurrent use.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/tr.summary: Reads Claude Code session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<uuid>.jsonl) into the canonical, tool-aware transcript.Event stream.
Reads Codex CLI rollout session transcripts (~/.codex/sessions/.../rollout-*.jsonl) into the canonical, tool-aware transcript.Event stream.
Reads Gemini CLI session transcripts (~/.gemini/tmp/<project>/chats/session-*.jsonl), accepting either observed line shape, into the canonical Event stream.
Reads pi coding-agent session transcripts (<config>/sessions/--<cwd-slug>--/*.jsonl, format v3) into the canonical transcript.Event stream.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/tu.summary: The single source of truth for the neutral structured-turn protocol: exit codes, deadline anchor, and the frozen StructuredTurnResult schema shared by guest producer and host client.
Translates low-level harness signals (emulated screen changes + wrapper status) into a small vocabulary of chat turn events; Watcher composes session, screen, and Adapter.

Adapter.description: Per-harness contract translating screen state and wrapper status into turn events; OnScreen/OnWrapperStatus must be safe for concurrent calls.

BusyDetector.description: Optional adapter capability reporting from the rendered screen whether the harness is still working on the current turn versus idle at the prompt.

MessageExtractor.description: Optional adapter capability that recovers the assistant's reply text from the rendered screen, stripped of TUI chrome.

Quitter.description: Optional adapter capability surfacing the key sequence that makes the interactive harness exit gracefully instead of being SIGTERM'd.

RawSessionIDExtractor.description: Optional adapter capability surfacing the harness's session ID from a single raw PTY output line rather than the rendered screen.

SessionIDExtractor.description: Optional adapter capability surfacing the harness's session ID by scraping the rendered screen snapshot.

SessionIDLocator.description: Optional adapter capability recovering the harness session ID from on-disk state keyed on the working directory, as a fallback at turn completion.

TranscriptReader.description: Optional adapter capability providing access to the harness's persisted conversation log to hydrate Conversation.History().

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/tu.summary: Fallback turn-detection adapter that maps wrapper.Status transitions directly to turn events without reading screen contents; a safety net when no per-harness adapter exists.
Turn-detection adapter for the Claude Code CLI keying on the '✻ <verb> for Ns' thinking-summary line and interrupt marker; embeds generic.Adapter for wrapper status events.
Turn-detection adapter for the Codex CLI (legacy Token-usage footer marker; 0.142+ relies on chat idle-completion) embedding generic.Adapter for wrapper status events.
Turn-detection adapter for the Gemini CLI: end-of-turn/session-id markers not yet identified, so it embeds generic.Adapter until a corpus recording exists.
Turn-detection adapter for the OpenCode CLI: screen markers and transcript reading not yet identified, so it embeds generic.Adapter until a corpus recording exists.
Turn-detection adapter for the pi coding agent: transcript reading and graceful /quit implemented; end-of-turn screen marker awaits a corpus, embedding generic.Adapter.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/ve.summary: Reads the repo-root versions.json pinning each supported harness CLI to an upstream package version, the source of truth tying adapters and corpus tests to a release.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/wr.summary: Supervises an external CLI agent harness under a pseudoterminal, observing its output and lifecycle and returning a normalized Status; callers own persistence.

Classifier.description: Inspects recent harness output and reports actionable status classifications; stateless (input rebuilt each poll) and safe for concurrent use.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/pkg/wr.summary: Generic pattern primitives for harness classifiers (substring/prompt-suffix matching, retry-after and reset-time parsing) over ANSI-stripped recent output; stateless.
Classifier patterns for the Claude Code CLI harness, including conservative API-error and session-limit matchers over ANSI-stripped output.
Classifier patterns for the OpenAI Codex CLI harness, including an API-error matcher keyed on inner phrases across both TUI and exec display paths.
Classifier patterns for the Cursor CLI harness: conservative idle-gated Cost/Retry/Prompt fingerprints only (an anchored API-error matcher is a deliberate follow-up).
Classifier patterns for Google's Gemini CLI, seeded from observed API-error surfaces and Ink-TUI prompt shapes, including a 429-inferring API-error matcher.
Classifier patterns for the provider-agnostic OpenCode CLI: conservative cross-provider Cost/Retry fingerprints with no single anchored API-error format (APIError left nil).
Classifier patterns for the provider-agnostic pi coding agent: conservative cross-provider Cost/Retry fingerprints with no single anchored API-error format (APIError left nil).
Diagnostic event vocabulary for the harness wrapper: Emitter implementations route lifecycle events to writers or slog; observability only, not part of the API stability surface.

Emitter.description: Receives wrapper diagnostic events; implementations (writer, slog) must be safe for concurrent use.

github.com/olesho/harness-wrapper/test/f.summary: Standalone mock interactive-agent CLI for pkg/wrapper tests: prints a banner and runs a --mode-selected behavior (completed, failed, stuck, needs-input, cost-limited, api-error).
